units.source_text: 皎洁的月光下，托喀交叉抱着胳膊，隔着小窗一动不动的看着那五只河童共进晚餐的温馨场景。

en.t: Under the bright, clear moonlight, Tokka stood with his arms folded, motionlessly watching through the small window the warm scene of the five kappas sharing dinner together.

units.source_text: 过了一会儿，他说：“无论如何，那家里的炒鸡蛋应该比恋爱有益健康啊。”

en.t: After a while, he said, "In any case, the scrambled eggs in that household must be healthier than love."
